# Situation
Apple Inc. (ticker AAPL) reported FY2026 revenue of $478.8 billion, +15.1% on the prior year, per the 10-K filed 2026-11-03.
# Financial profile
Operating income was $158.1 billion, a 33.0% operating margin. Net income was $132.2 billion and operating cash flow was $145.1 billion.
# Valuation view
Valuation is not drafted in this canned text. See the DCF and trading comps workbooks in the deal library for the sourced valuation ranges.
# Key risks
Concentration in a small number of product lines, supply-chain dependence and regulatory exposure should be tested in diligence.
# Next steps
Confirm the figures above against the filing, agree the valuation approach with the deal team and list the diligence requests.
